$metadata.description: Component tier, every token here references semantic. Components are the contract AI tools read when generating code. Each component block follows the CBDS metadata structure (TJ Petrie, SmashingConf Amsterdam 2026): name, variants, states, tokens, usage, don't-use-for.

bella.name: Button
bella.rendersAs: a button, or one anchor with href
bella.description: Keycaps with real hierarchy: an ink primary keycap, an outlined secondary, an ink text tier; one primary per view (brand refresh, 2026-09-22: no accent colour on buttons, the ochre ring means focus only). Labels are Geist caps, never Unique.
usage: The primary contact CTA reads "Let's talk" (brand refresh, 2026-09-22)
dont: Do not render more than one primary per view: the keycap is the single 3D moment
Do not use for filters, toggles, or sort: that is FilterChip / SegmentedControl / Select territory
Do not set labels in Unique at any size
Do not build a neutral keycap: that tier is retired
Do not lift a button on hover: lift is reserved for cards; hover is the label roll
Do not add the trace ring to a button: the trace is Card's affordance
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: primary label (text-inverse) 16.0:1 on the ink plate, 10.6:1 light / 11.8:1 dark on the hover plate (AAA). Secondary and tertiary labels are ink, 16.7:1 on panel. Secondary outline border-strong 3.00:1 worst (non-text AA). Focus ring 3px ochre-deep (3.20:1 on panel) / ochre (8.70:1 on the dark surface), 3px offset, focus-visible only.

restState.description: One job per state. At rest the keycap is calm: plate, gloss, edge, resting key shadow, label. Hover and focus-visible roll the label and shift the colour on every tier (primary plate, secondary fill, tertiary label); the button never lifts. Active is the keycap press, primary only. Reduced motion: colour only, the shift stays and the roll and press drop. audit:quality asserts the invariants on every story rendering the component (root carries data-bella-component=button).

default.$description: Every tier shares the keycap radius (lg): the keycap is the signature, and one radius makes the tiers read as one family.

pill.$description: shape="pill": fully rounded ends, e.g. the nav call to action.

roll-duration.$description: Label roll on hover and focus-visible.

press.$description: Primary :active sinks onto the reduced plate. Down only, never up.

fill-hi-hover.$description: Hover and focus-visible: the ink plate eases one step lighter (ink-hover in both themes). A colour shift, not a lift; it stays under reduced motion.

gloss.$description: Resting sheen. White alpha, the permitted translucent overlay; never a solid fill.

gloss-pressed.$value: linear-gradient(transparent 0 10%, color-mix(in srgb, white 12%, transparent) 10%, transparent 50%)

border.$description: The 3:1 control outline at rest (brand refresh, 2026-09-22).

border-hover.$description: Hover and focus-visible: the outline goes ink.

foreground.$description: Ink with an underline (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): links are ink.

underline-thickness.$description: The one static underline on the roll window. The rolling spans reserve offset + thickness below the text for it.

foreground-hover.$description: Stays ink on hover and focus-visible; the underline thickens instead.

underline-thickness-hover.$description: Hover and focus-visible: the underline thickens to 2px.

bella.name: Card
bella.rendersAs: a div; with href one anchor, with onClick one button
bella.description: The one-card system: every card surface renders through this. Calm at rest, theme-aware by construction; the only fixed-light path is Peek, on purpose.
dont: Do not nest cards inside cards
Do not use for navigation, that's nav-link's job
Do not nest links or buttons inside an interactive card: the card is ONE link or ONE button
Do not build a fixed-dark card, no fixed-dark path exists; peek (fixed always-light paper on navy) is the one recorded fixed-context exception
bella.a11y: Interactive cards render as a single anchor or button: one tab stop, no nested interactives. Name a card via ariaLabel when its visible content isn't the right name; media is aria-hidden when ariaLabel is set. Focus shows a visible ring (asserted in CI, both themes). Only interactive cards lift on hover and focus; prefers-reduced-motion keeps them still (the shadow still marks hover and focus). Card text sits on surface-card: text-muted 4.64:1 light / 6.03:1 dark, the worst pair (AA).

anatomy.title: Hover shadow
anatomy.detail: interactive cards only: 2px lift plus shadow; reduced motion keeps the shadow, drops the lift

anatomy.title: Surface
anatomy.detail: the card fill, flat at rest

anatomy.title: Focus ring
anatomy.detail: interactive cards only: 3px, 3px offset, focus-visible only

bella.note: The variant token blocks elevated/glass/featured/inverse below predate the 0.3 Card and remain solely as value sources for the .bella-card-* utility classes emitted by build.py; they are NOT Card variants (the shipped API is default | peek; styling lives in Card.module.css). Their retirement rides on the glass-utility decision.

restState.description: FLAT AT REST is a contract (surface rules, 2026-09-19): only these layers may paint before hover/focus. audit:quality asserts the invariants on every story that renders the component (root carries data-bella-component=card).
hoverOnly: hover lift + shadow.hover, interactive cards only

invariants.note: the inner panel stays inside the wrapper; the grid double-surface class of bug

width.$description: Reserved trace-ring thickness (recorded trace geometry); keeps hover layout-stable.

duration.$description: One lap of the travelling ring. Card only: buttons have no trace.

bella.name: ResourceCard
bella.description: The folder card. A dark file window on top, a warm sheet below, and a tab folded up from the sheet itself so the two read as one piece of paper. Built for the toolkit gallery, where every item is a file you can open.
usage: The toolkit gallery, one card per installable skill
Any gallery where the items are files or documents with a type and a state
dont: Do not put a second link inside it: the whole card is one link, the Open action is a span that inherits it
Do not give the tab its own colour or a shadow: it is the sheet folded up, and a shadow breaks the fold
Do not write the description longer than two lines: it clamps, and a clamped third line reads as a bug
Do not colour the status dot yet: the ladder is unresolved (issue #1) and the neutral dot is the honest placeholder
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-30: title is text-primary on the surface, 12.81:1 light and 12.61:1 worst dark, AAA. Description is text-secondary, 7.74:1 light and 7.33:1 worst dark, AAA. Tab label and footer meta sit at the 13px metadata tier, text-secondary, same ratios. The Open action is text-accent, 5.96:1 light and 5.30:1 worst dark, AA, and never stands on colour alone: it carries the word Open beside the arrow. One link per card, so one tab stop.

restState.description: At rest the card is the cover, the sheet, the tab and the notch. Flat at rest like Card: no shadow; the lift and shadow are hover and focus only, inherited from Card. The notch is painted from the same semantic surface token as the sheet, so it flips with the theme instead of biting a light hole in the navy card.

cover-height.$description: Fixed cover well. A component-tier literal: there is no primitive size ramp, and the cover has to reserve its space before artwork loads or the whole grid jumps.

cover-background.$description: The file window is a fixed-context dark surface in BOTH themes, like Card's peek but dark: the neutral dark inset (style unify, 2026-09-22; was navy). Never pure black.

sheet-overlap.$description: How far the sheet is pulled up over the cover. Equals the tab row height plus its breathing room; change one and the fold stops lining up.

notch-size.$description: Radius of the concave corner joining the tab's right edge to the sheet's top edge. Matches tab-radius so the convex and concave curves are the same arc.

title-font-size.$description: The card-title floor. 20px, never smaller, whatever the reference implementation does.

description-font-size.$description: Reading text, so the 16px body floor applies. The reference sets 13px; BELLA cannot.

status-dot-color.$description: NEUTRAL ON PURPOSE, pending issue #1. The status ladder is unresolved, so a real semantic colour here would be invented. When the ladder lands this token gains per-state values and nothing else about the card changes.

bella.name: Tag
bella.description: Non-interactive metadata. If you can click it, it is not a Tag.
dont: Do not make it clickable: narrowing a set is FilterChip's job
Do not add a border: the flat wash is what separates it from interactive chips
Do not set the label in an accent or status colour: tints are wash-only here
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: default label is text-secondary, 7.74:1 on the surface-inset wash in light and 7.33:1 worst in dark, AAA both. Accent label is text-accent on the accent-subtle wash, 5.25:1 worst in light and 5.30:1 worst in dark, AA. Non-interactive: no tab stop, no pointer affordance, cursor default.

restState.description: A Tag is entirely static: the wash and the label are the whole component, in every state. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=tag).

font-family.$description: Geist sans: tags use the label style; mono is for tokens, code and hashes only (Elleta, 2026-10-03).

background.$description: Ochre fill with ink text (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): the accent is a fill.

bella.name: StatusPill
bella.description: A status word in a pill. Non-interactive, one tint per state, readable in both themes.
usage: neutral: a state that is neither good nor bad (not tested, draft, disabled), no tint (CHIP, 2026-10-03)
dont: Do not make it clickable: a pill that toggles is a FilterChip
Do not colour the label with the state tint: the tint is border and wash only, the word carries the meaning
Do not design new status UI on the carried tints without asking: the BELLA-native status ladder (issue #1) is pending and will restyle this
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: the label never depends on the tint. Accent label is text-accent, 5.66:1 light / 6.65:1 dark (AA). Success/info labels are text-secondary, AAA both themes. Tints as non-text rings: sage 4.33:1 on ground and 3.45:1 on navy (passes 3:1); steel 2.87:1 on ground (fails 3:1, wash-only per the recorded carry) and 5.20:1 on navy. The state is always readable from the word alone. CARRIED TINTS: pending the status-ladder sitting (issue #1).

restState.description: Entirely static, like Tag. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=status-pill).

font-family.$description: Geist sans: a status word uses the label style; mono is for tokens, code and hashes only (Elleta, 2026-10-03).

font-size.$description: The 13px floor. The portfolio's 11px is its own recorded exception; BELLA does not carry it.

background.$description: Ochre fill with ink text, no ring (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): the accent is a fill.

bella.name: FilterChip
bella.description: The toggle for narrowing a set. Pressed is a real state with real semantics, not a restyle.
usage: size compact: a long wrapping row of tag filters (CHIP Docs); the 44px target stays
dont: Do not use for mutually exclusive views: that is SegmentedControl
Do not raise it: the keycap is reserved for true actions
Do not fake the state with colour alone: aria-pressed is the state, the fill is its paint
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: real button with aria-pressed, both themes. Default label text-secondary on transparent, 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Pressed is the inverse fill: ground-on-ink 16.06:1 light, navy-on-dark-inverse equivalent in dark (AAA). Focus ring independent. Hit area 44px minimum (the touch-target token; the portfolio 32px chip is a recorded divergence, below the 2.5.5 Enhanced floor BELLA holds).

anatomy.title: Hover wash
anatomy.detail: border-subtle wash, the edge goes ink

anatomy.title: Pressed fill
anatomy.detail: inverse fill, label text-inverse; aria-pressed is the state

restState.description: At rest the chip is the flat outline and its label; hover wash and the pressed fill are state paints. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=filter-chip).

bella.name: SegmentedControl
bella.description: Pick one view among a few, all options visible. The selected state lives in ARIA, not just paint.
usage: Work library view switcher (Cards / Map / Table)
Any mutually exclusive view pick with few options
dont: Do not use for multi-select: that is FilterChip

Do not use radiogroup or tablist semantics: plain buttons with aria-current, per the recorded discovery pass (W3C APG radio rejected: single tab stop plus arrow-select blocks surveying; Primer SegmentedControl guidance matches)
Do not hide options behind it: if they do not all fit, it is a Select
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: each segment is a real button; Tab moves between segments, Enter/Space selects, arrows deliberately inert; aria-current=true marks the selection in the tree; the group carries a required aria-label. Segment icons are a decorative leading slot, aria-hidden, sized by the icon tokens; the text label always stays and carries the name (restored 2026-07-22 after the first extraction dropped it, a recorded divergence). Labels text-secondary 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA); selected label text-accent on accent-subtle, 5.25:1 worst light / 5.30:1 worst dark (AA). Focus ring inset. Segments hit the 44px touch-target token (portfolio 38px is a recorded divergence).

restState.description: Flat always: the group border, dividers, and the selected fill are the whole paint. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=segmented-control).

bella.name: Select
bella.description: For long lists only. If the options fit on screen, chips or a segmented control do it better.
dont: Do not hand-roll a listbox: the native select owns the popup, the keyboard model, and the assistive-tech semantics
Do not drop the visible label: an unlabelled dropdown is a guess
Do not use it for a handful of visible options: SegmentedControl or FilterChip
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: native select labelled by containment; the platform popup needs no re-verification. Closed control: text-primary on surface, 16.92:1 light (AAA); label text-secondary 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Option text at 14px is the closed-control field; the popup renders at platform size. Focus ring on the field; 44px min-height via the touch-target token.

restState.description: Flat always: field, border, chevron, label. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=select).

bella.name: Heading
bella.description: Geist Light 300 carries every heading tier, tight tracking, sentence case (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta). Unique is the wordmark only. Never inside a card.
dont: Never inside a card: cards carry titles (Geist 500), not headings (contract-enforced by audit:quality)
Never below 32px: the section tier floors at 32px
Never Unique: the wordmark is the only Unique
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: text-primary 18.73:1 light (bg) / 16.60:1 dark (bg), AAA. The accent segment is the muted half-line, text-secondary, 7.09:1 light / 7.06:1 dark (AAA): ochre is a fill, never text. Semantic level decouples from the visual tier via the as prop, so the outline stays honest.

restState.description: Type only, entirely static; and a Heading may never sit inside a Card. audit:quality asserts both (root carries data-bella-component=heading).

invariants.note: Headings never render inside a card

bella.name: Icon
bella.description: The only way BELLA renders an icon. Iconoir glyphs from an inlined registry, icon-token sized, always currentColor; decorative by default, a label makes it meaningful.
dont: Do not put id attributes inside an icon SVG: the glyph renders more than once (the Button label roll duplicates it), so an id-referenced gradient or clip would collide; draw with paths and currentColor only (audit:quality enforces)
Do not mix icon sets or draw one-off SVGs: Iconoir is the ONLY source (declared 2026-07-22) and every glyph lives in the registry, nothing inline (audit:quality enforces)
Do not import an icon library component surface: the registry carries the paths BELLA ships (borrow-behavior-only, recorded)
Do not hardcode an icon colour: currentColor inherits the themed ink
Do not let a meaningful icon stand without text unless its accessible name is proven in a Behavior story; decorative is the default and needs no name
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: aria-hidden by default (decorative); with label, role=img plus aria-label. Colour is always currentColor, so contrast rides on the text token of the context. Sizes from the icon tokens (sm 16 / md 20 / lg 24), stroke from icon.stroke.

restState.description: Static glyph. audit:quality has no elevation to assert; the invariants hold trivially.

bella.name: Avatar
bella.description: A person or entity as a circle. An image when there is one, the initials of the name when there is not, never an empty grey disc.
usage: A portrait beside a name and role
The identity slot in a contact panel
dont: Do not use it as a decorative circle: an Avatar stands for someone, a plain disc is artwork
Do not ship it without a name: the initials fallback is the point, an empty disc is a bug
Do not put a status dot on it yet: the status ladder is unresolved (issue #1)
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-30: initials are text-secondary on the surface-inset wash, 7.74:1 in light and 7.33:1 worst in dark, AAA both. With an image the img carries alt; without one the root is role=img labelled by name and the initials are aria-hidden, so it announces once, as the person, never as two letters.

restState.description: An Avatar is entirely static. The ring is a rest-state affordance, not a hover one: it is either on or off, it never animates. audit:quality asserts it never transforms or animates (root carries data-bella-component=avatar).

border-color.$description: The disc always needs an edge. In dark, surface-inset resolves to the same navy as the page ground, so a fill alone makes the disc vanish on an unfilled page; this border draws the circle whatever it sits on.

ring-width.$description: Ring stroke. A component-tier literal on purpose: there is no primitive ring scale, and the alternative is a hard-coded value in build.py, which is the class of thing issue #3 is about.

ring-gap.$description: Gap between the disc edge and the ring, painted in the surrounding ground so the ring reads as separate.

bella.name: Eyebrow
bella.description: Sans label above a heading, 14px, no tracking, no caps (label style; mono is for tokens, code and hashes only, Elleta, 2026-10-03). Signals context or category.
dont: Do not use as a heading: eyebrows complement a heading, never replace one
Never an accent colour: wayfinding is not action
Never below 13px, never tracked, never uppercased
bella.a11y: 13px floor. muted: text-secondary, 7.09:1 worst light / 7.06:1 worst dark (AAA). ink: text-primary (AAA). Verified 2026-09-22.

restState.description: Type only, entirely static.

bella.name: Input
bella.description: Labelled, stateful, honest about errors. The form is the channel, so the fields carry the trust.
usage: Any labelled free-text entry; multiline renders the textarea
dont: Do not use placeholder as the label: the label is always rendered and wired with for/id
Do not fake errors with colour alone: aria-invalid plus a role=alert message wired via aria-describedby is the pattern
Do not signal an error with colour alone: the danger border always comes with the WarningCircle icon, the message and aria-invalid
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: real label element (for/id), 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Field text text-primary on surface, 16.92:1 light (AAA); placeholder text-muted, 4.67:1 worst (AA, opacity reset for Firefox). Errors (status tokens, 2026-09-22): aria-invalid + role=alert message via aria-describedby; 2px danger-border (3:1+ on every surface), WarningCircle icon, message in danger-text (5.84:1 light on panel, 6.86:1 dark on raised; AA). Focus: the 3px focus ring (3px offset) plus an ink edge; an invalid field keeps its danger edge under the ring. 44px min-height.

anatomy.title: Label
anatomy.detail: Geist 13, 700, caps; a real label wired for/id

anatomy.title: Placeholder
anatomy.detail: text-muted, opacity reset for Firefox; never the label

anatomy.title: Focus ring
anatomy.detail: 3px, 3px offset, and the edge goes ink

restState.description: Flat always: field, border, label, messages. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=input).

font-size.$description: Form entry is body text, 16px; it also defeats iOS zoom-on-focus.

bella.name: Link
bella.rendersAs: an anchor; external opens a new tab
bella.description: Inline text link inside body copy: ink with an underline; hover thickens the underline; focus is the shared ochre ring (brand refresh, 2026-09-22). Visited stays ink.
dont: Do not use for primary navigation, that's nav-link
Do not rely on color alone, always underlined or weight-shifted on hover
bella.a11y: Ink foreground on ground passes AAA (16.06:1, verified 2026-07-21). Link affordance is the underline; hover thickens it to 2px (brand refresh, 2026-09-22). Ink throughout.

underline-thickness-hover.$description: Hover thickens the underline to 2px (brand refresh, 2026-09-22).

bella.name: Nav Link
bella.description: Top-level navigation item. Geist, uppercase-lite. Active state reads as text-primary with a 2px accent underline, the accent is decoration, the text carries the letters.
dont: Do not mix nav-link and inline-link in the same cluster
Do not color-distinguish the active state with accent-colored text, use the accent underline token instead
bella.a11y: min-height hits 44px, critical for mobile nav. Active variant uses text-primary (AAA on ground and navy, verified 2026-07-21) with a 2px accent border-bottom as the affordance, the accent stays non-text decoration.

bella.name: Section
bella.rendersAs: a section labelled by its h2
bella.description: A vertical slice of a page (layout foundation, 2026-10-03): an h2 at the one section size, an optional lede and actions, then the body. The id makes it an anchor for an On this page list, and the anchor clears a sticky header. Sections are spaced by layout.section.space on every page. The default group (padding, max-width) is the portfolio's older section box; the container now comes from layout.container.
usage: Every block of a page below the PageHeader
Health: Readiness map, Usage, Open failures, Components
dont: Do not nest sections inside sections: inside a section, use Card titles
Do not leave out the heading: a block with no heading is a Columns or a Card
Do not set your own margins between sections: the section space is the rhythm
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a section element named by its h2 (aria-labelledby); the h2 is 32px text-primary (AAA, the section-heading floor); the lede is text-secondary (AAA) held to 70ch; scroll-margin keeps an anchored heading clear of a sticky header.

restState.description: Type only, entirely static.

bella.name: Modal
bella.description: Modal dialog scaffold. Backdrop blur over the page content, centered dialog surface above.
dont: Do not nest modals
Do not use for non-blocking UI, use a drawer or popover instead
bella.a11y: Focus trap required. Escape to close. aria-modal='true'. Backdrop blur must be gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference for AAA 2.3.3 compliance.

bella.name: BrandWordmark
bella.description: The ELLETA / BELLA wordmark (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): custom E, L, T, A, B stroke glyphs at the locked settings (weight 12, width 58, height 130, tracking 16, soft corners; the E, A and B bars on one low line), filled with the seeded brand pattern and a grain, or in plain ink.
usage: The BELLA name on its own pages
dont: Never below 32px tall
Never recolour the pattern: it only comes from color.pattern.*
Never as body type or a heading: it is a mark, not a typeface
Never animate it
bella.a11y: role=img with the word as its accessible name; the pattern layers are aria-hidden. The ink variant is text-primary (AAA). Static: nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.

restState.description: Entirely static.

bella.name: PatternField
bella.description: The brand pattern as a hero background (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): greyscale at about 7% (inverted grey at about 6% in dark) with a radial fade. Replaces the dot grid.
usage: Behind a page opening or hero, first child of a position: relative container
dont: Never behind body text at more than its token opacity
Never in colour: the colour pattern belongs to the wordmark
Never interactive
bella.a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden, focusable=false, pointer-events none. At 7% greyscale it does not reduce text contrast measurably; axe checks the text over it.

restState.description: Entirely static.

opacity.$description: 7% light, 6% dark, through the semantic opacity token.

bella.name: Callout
bella.description: A quiet aside beside the content it qualifies (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta; from the reference's .note and .tbd). note: a hairline rule on the left, 13px muted text. gap: a dashed muted frame with a sans label, marking words the author still owes. Static: no interaction, no motion.
usage: note: a caveat or source line under a figure or section
gap: a visible placeholder for content still to be written
dont: Not a status banner: no info, success, warning or error variants
Never interactive: no hover, no lift, never a link as a whole
No colour: hairline or dashed muted frame only, no chip fill, no accent
gap is a visible TODO: never ship it as finished copy
bella.a11y: note: text-secondary, AAA (2026-09-22). gap: label (sans) in text-primary, body in text-secondary, AAA; the dashed frame is decorative (text carries the meaning). No landmark role.

restState.description: Entirely static.

bella.name: Tabs
bella.description: Switch between panels that share one place on the page (CHIP components, 2026-10-03). W3C APG tabs with automatic activation; each tab owns a panel. Optional run state per tab, drawn as a dot and spoken as text.
usage: Any set of panels where one shows at a time
dont: Do not use to switch a view of the same content: that is SegmentedControl
Do not use for navigation between pages: that is NavList
Do not mark the selected tab with colour alone: ink text plus the 2px ink bar
Do not render panels without tabPanelProps: aria-controls must resolve
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: tablist with a required aria-label; one tab stop (roving tabindex); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move and select with wrap, Home/End jump; aria-selected and aria-controls in the tree, each panel labelled by its tab. Labels text-secondary 7.94:1 light / 9.06:1 dark at rest (AAA), selected text-primary 18.73:1 / 16.60:1 on the page (AAA); the selected bar is ink (non-text, far above 3:1). Run state is a filled ink dot or an idle border-strong ring (3.00:1 worst) and also text in the name. Focus ring 3px, inset. Tabs hit the 44px touch-target token.

anatomy.title: Selected bar
anatomy.detail: 2px ink bar under the selected tab

anatomy.title: Labels
anatomy.detail: Geist 14, 500; muted at rest, ink when selected

anatomy.title: Run dots
anatomy.detail: ink fill running, control ring idle

restState.description: Flat: the hairline, the selected bar and the labels are the whole paint. audit:quality asserts no elevation or animation (root carries data-bella-component=tabs).

bella.name: Kbd
bella.description: A keyboard shortcut in Mono keycaps (CHIP components, 2026-10-03). Semantic kbd, one recessed cap per key, with an optional spoken label for symbol keys. Static: it names keys, it does not press them.
usage: Shortcut hint inside a search field
Shortcut legend in a help menu
Inline in body copy that names a shortcut
dont: Do not make it clickable: a pressable keycap is Button
Do not raise or animate it: the raised keycap is Button's, Kbd is recessed and flat
Do not leave a symbol key unlabelled: pass label so screen readers say the shortcut, not the glyph
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a kbd element with nested kbd per key, never focusable. With label, the glyphs are aria-hidden and the label is read. Caps text-secondary on surface-inset, 7.09:1 light / 7.69:1 dark (AAA). The cap edge is a decorative hairline. Mono at the 13px floor.

restState.description: Entirely static, like Tag. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=kbd).

border.$description: Decorative hairline: a Kbd is not a control.

bella.name: NavList
bella.description: A sidebar of grouped links (CHIP components, 2026-10-03). Where you are is aria-current, painted as a wash plus ink plus medium weight. Optional sans group labels, counts, a footer row and a hide / show toggle.
usage: Any app sidebar of views or sections
dont: Do not use for the site's top nav: that is the nav-link contract
Do not use for in-page panels: that is Tabs
Do not mark the current item with a wash alone: aria-current plus ink plus weight
Do not collapse without onToggle: the lists would be unreachable
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a nav landmark with a required aria-label; groups with a heading are lists labelled by it; the current item is aria-current=page. Labels text-secondary at rest, 7.09:1 light / 8.44:1 dark on panel (AAA); hover and current go text-primary, current on the border-subtle wash 14.60:1 / 12.26:1 (AAA); counts go ink on the current wash (muted would be 6.18:1). The toggle is a real button with aria-expanded, aria-controls and a spoken Hide / Show name; its icon is decorative. Focus ring 3px, inset. Rows and the toggle hit the 44px touch-target token.

restState.description: Flat: text rows and the current wash. audit:quality asserts no elevation or animation (root carries data-bella-component=nav-list).

bella.name: Stat
bella.description: One figure with its label and an optional change (CHIP components, 2026-10-03). A term-description pair: a sans label, a light display figure in tabular numerals, a change line whose direction is an arrow plus a spoken word, never colour. An optional sparkline (series, two points or more) draws the history as a 1px ink line, spoken as one sentence.
usage: CHIP health figures (components, failures, indexed chunks, last sync)
Any small row of headline figures on a Card or panel
dont: Do not colour the change: up is not always good, and the status ladder has no neutral change colour
Do not invent figures: a Stat shows a real count or nothing
Do not give it its own box: place Stats on a Card or panel
Do not draw a sparkline from fewer than two real points, and never from made-up history
Do not colour the sparkline: its shape carries the trend
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a dl with a dt label and dd figure, so the label names the figure. The trend arrow is aria-hidden and a spoken Up / Down precedes the change. Figure text-primary, label and change text-secondary, all AAA on the page and on panel (7.09:1 light / 8.44:1 dark worst for muted). Tabular numerals. The sparkline is role=img with an aria-label that says the first and last values and the number of points (or seriesLabel); line and end dot text-primary, 3:1+ as non-text on page and panel in both themes.

anatomy.title: Change line
anatomy.detail: Geist 14, muted; arrow hidden, direction spoken

anatomy.title: Sparkline
anatomy.detail: 1px ink line and end dot, 80 by 24; shown with two or more points

restState.description: Entirely static. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=stat).

trend-stroke.$description: Ink. The line's shape is the signal; it never takes a status or accent colour.

bella.name: ScoreStrip
bella.description: One system's readiness (CHIP components, 2026-10-03): an overall score with an ink bar, then one cell per station, banded sturdy (80 to 100), drifting (60 to 79) or check engine (under 60). Self-assessed stations (null) say Self-assessed in a dashed frame, never a fill. Cells carry full station names and wrap into rows; no abbreviations. Ships with ScoreLegend and scoreBand.
usage: CHIP readiness map, fed by the station scores in bella.json
Any per-dimension score for a named system
dont: Do not invent a warning colour for the mid band: it stays neutral until the status ladder adds one (issue #1)
Do not show a self-assessed score as a measured number
Do not drop ScoreLegend from a map: the bands need their key
Do not rely on the wash: the edge, the figure and the spoken band carry the meaning
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a region labelled by the system heading (level set by as); stations are a labelled list, each spoken as full name, value of 100 and band word, or self-assessed; the visible figure and short label are aria-hidden duplicates. Cell text is ink on every wash, 16.24:1 light / 12.23:1 dark worst (AAA; muted would fall to 6.68:1). Band edges are status borders at 3:1 or better on panel (success, danger) or the control border (3.00:1); the washes alone are near 1:1 on light panel and never carry meaning. The overall bar is aria-hidden, ink on the border-subtle track (14.60:1 / 12.26:1).

restState.description: Entirely static. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=score-strip).
atRest: station cells with band edge and wash

cell-min-width.$description: Wide enough for a full station name; cells wrap into rows rather than abbreviate.

bella.name: DataTable
bella.description: Rows of facts in columns (CHIP components, 2026-10-03). Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort, the header sticks, figures are right-aligned and tabular, and an optional single selection fills the chosen row ochre without dimming any other row.
usage: Any comparison of the same facts across many items
dont: Do not dim unselected rows: selection is the ochre fill, everything else keeps its paint
Do not use ochre-deep for selection: it is the focus ring only
Do not left-align figures: numeric columns are right-aligned and tabular
Do not drop the caption: it names the table
Do not use density compact on a sortable or selectable table: interactive rows keep the 44px target (the component ignores compact there)
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a real table with a visible caption; column headers scope=col, the first cell of each row scope=row. Sortable headers hold a button and carry aria-sort (none, ascending, descending); the arrow is decorative. Selection is a toggle button with aria-pressed in the row header; the selected row is ochre fill with ink text, 9.01:1 (AAA), nested components included (a muted StatusPill label on ochre would be 3.51:1), and no other row changes. Header labels text-secondary on panel, 7.09:1 light / 8.44:1 dark (AAA). With maxHeight the scroll wrapper is a focusable region named by the caption. Sort and select buttons hit the 44px touch-target token; focus ring 3px.

restState.description: Flat: rules, the sticky header and the cell text. audit:quality asserts no elevation or animation (root carries data-bella-component=data-table).

selected-background.$description: Selection is the ochre fill (highlight, never dim).

bella.name: Drawer
bella.description: A panel that slides in from the left (or the right, side=right) over a scrim (CHIP components, 2026-10-03). A native modal dialog: the page behind is inert, Esc closes it, focus returns to the trigger. For navigation on small screens.
usage: Any navigation or filter panel that cannot stay on screen at phone width
dont: Do not use it as a page section: it is a modal and blocks the page
Do not open it without a visible trigger: focus has to return somewhere
Do not dim content inside the panel: the scrim covers the page, never the drawer
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a native <dialog> opened with showModal(), named by its visible title (aria-labelledby). The rest of the page is inert while it is open, so Tab stays inside. Esc, the Close button and a click on the scrim close it; focus returns to the element that opened it. Title and content text-primary on the raised surface, 16.73:1 light / 12.93:1 dark (AAA). The slide is 250ms and is dropped under prefers-reduced-motion.

restState.description: Closed, it renders an empty dialog element the browser hides. Open, it slides in once and holds still.

width.$description: Most of a phone screen, never wider than a sidebar.

bella.name: Combobox
bella.description: One field over a grouped list (CHIP components, 2026-10-03): the ARIA combobox pattern. Typing opens the list, Up and Down move the active option while focus stays in the field, Enter chooses it, Esc closes the list. The active option is the ochre fill.
usage: CHIP's one input: jump to a component or doc, or ask OBI
Any field that picks from a grouped, filtered list
dont: Do not move focus into the list: focus stays in the field and the active option is aria-activedescendant
Do not dim the other options: the active one gets the ochre fill, nothing else changes
Do not use it for a fixed short list without typing: that is Select
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: input role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-autocomplete=list; the list is role=listbox named by the label, groups are role=group named by their heading, options are role=option with aria-selected on the active one, referenced by aria-activedescendant. Esc closes the list and stops there; a second Esc belongs to the page. Option and field text ink on the panel (AAA), group headings and meta text-secondary (AAA), the active option ink on ochre 9.01:1 (AAA). Options and field are 44px. Focus ring on the field.

restState.description: Closed: the field alone. Open: the list floats with the large shadow.

active-background.$description: The active option is the ochre fill (highlight, never dim).

bella.name: Disclosure
bella.rendersAs: a native details with its summary
bella.description: One open/close section (Atlas v4, 2026-10-03, Elleta: a stack of open/close sections so a card fits the screen). The header row is the whole 44px target and carries a short summary, so a closed section still says something.
usage: Facts, Checks, Tokens and Notes on the Atlas Facts card
Any long card that should fit the screen closed
dont: Do not use it for navigation or to switch views: that is Tabs or SegmentedControl
Do not hide the one thing people came for: keep the main section open by default
Do not nest a disclosure inside another
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: native details/summary, so the expanded state is announced and Enter or Space toggles it. The header row is at least 44px; title AAA and summary AA on panel in light, warm and dark; the hairline is a divider only; focus is the shared ring; the chevron does not turn under reduced motion.

restState.description: Closed: a hairline, the title, the summary and a chevron pointing down.

bella.name: ActionChip
bella.rendersAs: a button, or one anchor with href
bella.description: The quiet action (CHIP components, 2026-10-03, Elleta): a sentence-case pill for suggestions, chips and the small actions under an answer. Below secondary in weight; not a toggle and not the page's main action.
usage: Small actions on a tile (Which have none?)
dont: Do not set it in caps: sentence case is the point
Do not use it as a filter or toggle: that is FilterChip with aria-pressed
Do not use it for the main action of a view: that is Button primary
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a real button (or a link with href), 44px. Label ink on the page and on panel (AAA in light, warm and dark); the control border clears 3:1 on every surface; hover adds the hairline wash and the edge goes ink; focus is the shared ring.

restState.description: Flat always: the control-border pill and its label. audit:quality asserts no elevation or animation (root carries data-bella-component=action-chip).

bella.name: PageHeader
bella.rendersAs: a header with the page's one h1
bella.description: The top of every page (layout foundation, 2026-10-03, Elleta: one page-title size on every page, not display). A quiet meta line (breadcrumb, source or category), the page title at one fixed 40px, an optional lede held to the body measure, and an optional actions row.
usage: The first block of every page template: Overview, Object page, Library and Settings
Atlas: the component name, its category and number as meta
dont: Do not use a display Heading tier for an app page title: display is for editorial heroes
Do not put more than one keycap Button in actions: the main action only; the rest are secondary Buttons or ActionChips
Do not use it twice on a page: one h1
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: one h1; the title is text-primary (AAA); meta and lede are text-secondary (AAA on the page ground in light, warm and dark); the lede holds to 70ch; the title balances its lines.

restState.description: Type only, entirely static.

bella.name: SidebarLayout
bella.rendersAs: a grid of an aside, the content and an optional rail
bella.description: A sticky aside beside the content, with an optional rail on the right (layout foundation, 2026-10-03). On the 12-column grid: aside 3 and content 9, or aside 3, content 6 and rail 3. Under 1200px of its own width the rail drops under the content; under 768px everything stacks and the aside stops sticking. The aside sticks under the sticky header (--header-height) and scrolls on its own when it is taller than the screen less the header and the dock (--dock-height).
usage: Atlas: the library beside the component
Docs: the list, the reader, the doc rail
Health: On this page, then the sections
dont: Do not put the page title in the aside: the PageHeader sits in the content column
Do not add another scroll container: only the aside list, code blocks and tables scroll on their own
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: the aside and rail are complementary landmarks named by asideLabel and railLabel; source order is aside, content, rail, so reading and keyboard order follow the visual order at every width; a scrolling aside is focusable so the keyboard can scroll it.

restState.description: Layout only, entirely static.

bella.name: Columns
bella.description: Two or three columns that collapse by their own width (layout foundation, 2026-10-03): three become two under 1200px and one under 768px; two become one under 768px. Even by default; split wide-start makes two columns 2:1 (a stage beside its facts). Cells stretch to the row, so cards in a row line up top and bottom.
usage: Atlas: the specimen beside its facts (wide-start), the examples under them (even)
dont: Do not use it for a sidebar: that is SidebarLayout
Do not nest Columns inside Columns
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: no landmark or role of its own; reading order is source order at every width.

restState.description: Layout only, entirely static.
